# Café counts and candidate areas in central Moscow

IBM Data Science Professional Certificate capstone (Coursera), started in 2019 and revisited in 2026.
[По-русски ниже](#по-русски).

A count model compares 364 grid cells within 6 km of Red Square. It predicts recorded cafés and
restaurants from nearby shops, services, infrastructure and distances. Negative residuals identify areas
for checking data and visiting in person. They **do not establish unmet demand or business profitability**.
Catchments are 250, 300 and 400 m straight-line circles, not walking isochrones.

![2026 count residuals and fieldwork shortlist](report/figures/fig10_opportunity_map_2026.png)

The analysis uses nested spatial validation with an 800 m buffer and 50 repeated block assignments.
Caps and scaling are fitted on training data; education measured in 2026 is excluded from the historical
model. Poisson-deviance D² of averaged out-of-fold predictions: **0.664** (2019), **0.668** (2026).
The shortlist includes split frequencies and prediction ranges. D² is not a business-success probability.
The 2019 register / 2026 OSM comparison does not measure verified openings, closures or market growth.

## Read and reproduce

- [Full report](report/REPORT.md) · [Отчёт на русском](report/REPORT.ru.md).
- [Interactive Russian page](report/report_ru.html): download and open in a browser.
- [Notebook 03](notebooks/03_cafe_location_analysis.ipynb): executed analysis and figures.
- [Data provenance](data/README.md), [count model](src/moscow_cafes/model.py), [tests](tests/).
- `report/`: complete scores, shortlists, split diagnostics, fold choices, figures and maps.

```bash
python -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
pytest
python scripts/run_analysis.py
```

The full run uses committed data offline and takes several minutes, depending on the machine. It executes
the notebook, then rebuilds both Markdown reports, README and the interactive HTML. For text-only changes,
run `python scripts/build_markdown_reports.py` and `python scripts/build_report_page.py` after updating
their builders. Runtime versions are recorded in `report/summary.json`.

Notebooks 01 and 02 are historical archives of the 2019 collection and Foursquare exploration. Their
obsolete APIs are not part of the reproduction path. The current analysis reprojects original WGS84
coordinates to UTM 37N; it does not use the archived UTM 33 distances or district selection logic.
`scripts/fetch_osm_data.py` optionally replaces the OSM snapshot; changing data requires a complete rerun.

## По-русски

Модель оценивает число записей о кафе и ресторанах на 364 участках центра Москвы. Отклонение от прогноза
помогает выбрать места для проверки; оно не доказывает свободный спрос или прибыльность нового кафе.
Радиусы считаются по прямой. Пешеходный поток, аренда и доступные помещения не измерены.

Исправлены эффекты `log1p` с обрезкой, утечка будущего слоя в историческую модель, подбор регуляризации
и пространственная проверка. Используются вложенная валидация, буфер 800 м и 50 разбиений;
публикуются частоты допуска и попадания в десятку. Порог допуска 80% — правило отбора, не вероятность успеха.
D² усреднённых прогнозов: **0.664** и **0.668**. Результаты двух источников не выдаются за реальную
историю открытий и закрытий. Подробности и новый список — в [отчёте](report/REPORT.ru.md).
